findings.question: encumber

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: In certain circumstances (set out in the Group Disclosure and External Communications Policy) Directors and members of the Executive Leadership Team are required to inform the Group Company Secretary where a financier demands payment under a Margin Loan and there is a risk that the demand will not be able to be satisfied without the disposal of Group Securities.
findings.reasoning: The policy treats a lender's forced sale as something to be reported to the Group Company Secretary rather than as a breach or something requiring pre-clearance.
